# Delivery Skill: review guide

Status: draft for review; not an installed skill.

## Outcome

A delivery guide with destination rules, version rules, and a handover checklist.

Reader: Agents building and handing over reviewed outcomes

## Procedure

### 1. Identify the owner

Name the Studio or work level that owns the product.

### 2. Select the clean version

Choose the reviewed material. Keep experiments in result.

### 3. Build from source

Generate the product, its preview and explanation deck. Never hand-edit generated output.

### 4. Place at destination

Map each piece to its intended use; render text or use the owning code builder.

### 5. Check and hand over

Open the real product, verify links and versions, and let a person mark acceptance or sending.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Every delivery names a source and destination.
- [ ] An existing sent version is preserved.
- [ ] The generated output opens and works.
- [ ] A successful build is not recorded as a human acceptance.

## Open design choice

How should a page show the difference between built, accepted, and sent?
